# Fabric Data Agent

> A community-driven resource hub for Microsoft Fabric Data Agents. Find curated articles, resources, videos, events, and tools related to building and using data agents in Microsoft Fabric.

## About
This website is a community resource for Microsoft Fabric Data Agent practitioners. It aggregates curated content including articles, learning resources, YouTube videos, upcoming events, and useful tools.

## Content Categories
- Articles: Curated articles about Fabric Data Agents with summaries
- Resources: Links to documentation, tutorials, and learning materials
- Videos: YouTube videos about Fabric Data Agents
- Events: Upcoming conferences, sessions, and meetups
- Tools: Useful tools for working with Fabric Data Agents

## URLs
- Articles: https://www.fabricdatagent.com/articles/
- Resources: https://www.fabricdatagent.com/resources/
- Videos: https://www.fabricdatagent.com/videos/
- Events: https://www.fabricdatagent.com/events/
- Tools: https://www.fabricdatagent.com/tools/
- About: https://www.fabricdatagent.com/about/
- Contribute: https://www.fabricdatagent.com/contribute/

## Contributing
This site is GitHub-backed. Community members can contribute by submitting pull requests with new content in Markdown format.
